action_mapping_rule.applicability: The claims are requested only for one keel.mcp_action_mapping_evidence.v1 artifact with enforcement_surface_key=managed_mcp:action_mapping. The binding claim is always requested; the remaining claims follow from artifact_class.
action_mapping_rule.artifact_class_rule: execution is the pre-dispatch-claim artifact bound into the signed execution Permit and names neither relational claim. structural_decision is a non-approvable hold: it is not Permit evidence, has no approval group, and carries no resume or dispatch semantics. post_claim_execution is separate durable evidence emitted only after both relational claims commit, and is the only class that may name a dispatch claim. Only execution may be adjudicated through a Permit.
action_mapping_rule.identity_rule: For the execution class the artifact must be covered by the supported signed Permit resource-attributes commitment and its approval group must name that Permit as the execution Permit, with a distinct reviewed Permit.
action_mapping_rule.action_name_rule: permit_action_name must equal mcp.tool.call, and the target governance_action_id must not appear as the Permit action on any surface: the evidence block, the signed semantic binding's action name or operation, or the resolved fact profile's authorized action.
action_mapping_rule.basis_version_rule: challenge_basis_version must equal mcp_challenge_basis.v4. A basis hash is comparable only within an identical basis version: a superseded version is disproved and an unrecognised one is unverifiable_scope, with no fallback, reconstruction, or cross-version comparison.
action_mapping_rule.revision_rule: mapping_revision is a positive integer required in its own right. The manifest hash never substitutes for it: the manifest hash is invariant across a lifecycle transition that moves the epoch.
action_mapping_rule.certified_contract_rule: assurance=human_mapped_review_only requires certified_action_contract.state=absent and classification_provenance=human_approved_action_mapping. A present certified contract on an arbitrary human mapping is forged evidence and is disproved, never ignored, downgraded, or silently dropped.
action_mapping_rule.activation_rule: The activation reference is a binding, not a ceremony verification. activation.independently_verified must be false; independent verification of the WebAuthn assertion would require a bundle carrying the canonical activation record and sufficient signed or server-authenticated supporting evidence, and no such bundle reaches the verifier.
action_mapping_rule.relational_claim_rule: claim_record and dispatch_claim are typed objects. An absent state must name why it is absent and must carry no reference. execution requires both absent; post_claim_execution requires claim_record recorded and dispatch_claim acquired for the same governed request, at the mapping's own lifecycle epoch, on an active revision.
action_mapping_rule.approval_set_rule: approval_set_independently_established must be false. The unique consumption claim establishes single consumption, not which approvals satisfied the frozen requirement. A verifier may establish the approval set only from a bundle containing and validating the canonical qualifying attestations; without one it must say the approval set is not independently established.
action_mapping_rule.presentation_rule: Derived summaries, Permit-to-X titles, and disclaimer text are non-authorizing projections. A disclaimer never licenses a positive claim, and a positive claim is emitted only when the exact supporting artifacts are present. The interpretation sentence ends at 'under exact review, with the consequence-critical facts bound in the review material'; the truncated 'under mandatory review' form is forbidden because it would be emittable in exactly the case the specification withholds it.
action_mapping_rule.current_configuration_rule: Current mapping, catalog, or policy configuration is excluded and must never be inferred from or used to rewrite historical signed evidence.
